verdict.rationale: The docs describe a live preview "for human control" when a CAPTCHA challenge persists. They also describe a `live_view_url` from the `browser.ready` event, used to have a human enter a 2FA code before continuing in the same session. Event polling supports monitoring a run live. Missing for 10: in-depth live-preview documentation, an explicit pause/resume handoff during an active run (the 2FA pattern requires stopping the run at a checkpoint), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
